notes.title: The East Asia Indie Games Celebration is live on Steam!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/81c82ad63f303d90b91c5440f00754035664855c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Until August 19, explore a wide range of colorful games inspired by East Asian culture — from calming sims to bold, action-packed adventures.[/p][p]One of the highlights is The Way of the Tray — a waiter simulator in a Japanese spirit world setting, where mastering the delicate art of tray-balancing is your ultimate goal![/p][p]Try the demo now: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3373830/The_Way_of_the_Tray_Japanese_Restaurant_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Your efficiency can be improved both in the restaurant's kitchen and dining room
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/d2912c7faeaeb9e6c1ec0aefe462f89297972367.gif"][/img][/p][p]Your efficiency in The Way of the Tray can be improved both in the restaurant's kitchen and dining room![/p][p]For example, you can increase the size of the tray or improve its stability, and updated furniture in the dining room will generate more income. Additionally, various decorations will allow you to better control the workflow.[/p]

notes.title: Gilded dishes in The Way of the Tray are a great way to get rich!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/4cd7750a56e334c5a13231fca924da3fafd10622.gif"][/img][/p][p]Golden versions of dishes in The Way of the Tray double the price of a dish! There are several ways to obtain them, the most frequent one is through gifts left by guests after a perfect order.[/p]

notes.title: The restaurant in The Way of the Tray has a pretty extensive menu!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/720dc4c18dcdb05ec5fc6929f7077eda92af98c2.gif"][/img][/p][p]Seafood, meat dishes, snacks, sweets and drinks — even the most picky yokai will find something for themselves in this restaurant, and then order a dozen more servings. The perfect place to use your gifts on golden dishes![/p]

notes.title: Shirime - the guest without a face
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/27d324bdeaf0d9a2eedacc7abd99b6ff82ece962.gif"][/img][/p][p]Shirime sometimes visits the restaurant in The Way of the Tray. He's a good guy, but without a face, which doesn't stop him from eating well. Satisfying this perfectionist is not an easy task, and the cost of failure is a rapidly dwindling patience of other guests.[/p]

notes.title: Tsutsigumo - one of the guests at the restaurant in The Way of the Tray
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/1951f0812012ab7cb38c0c4e80a6bdffb6d7fdcd.gif"][/img][/p][p]Tsutsigumo is one of the guests at the restaurant in [i]The Way of the Tray[/i]. A earth spider who has lived so long that it became a yōkai. He enjoys meat dishes served with a large portion of soot. He unsuccessfully tried to get his children—Susugumo—employed at the restaurant, but now demands humane treatment of them when handling his order.[/p]

notes.title: The Way of the Tray playtest is now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45525517/89bd9bf66b3fb97d69928784931d88754f3aaf8a.png[/img]

During the playtest, participants can expect:
– Basic waiter mechanics in the restaurant hall and kitchen
– Introduction to the Chef and several yokai
– A few dishes, a couple of unique trays, and a series of enhancement gifts
– Partial restaurant upgrades

Each run will be time-limited, so try to unlock as much content as possible!

The playtest will run until April 7, with new participants invited daily.

Sign up now on the game page!
